headline: Hanoi Solves the Resource Problem for Double-Digit Growth
summary: Hanoi has set a GRDP growth target of 11% or more for 2026 and an average for 2026–2030. Investment needs exceed budget capacity, so state resources will take the lead, alongside credit, FDI and land.
why: Gross regional domestic product measures a city's economic output, and Hanoi is Vietnam's capital and a major investment hub for foreign investors.
